why_rejected.direct_channel_cannot_reach_the_strike: HYG genuinely holds 3.73% of NAV in pure AI-compute project credit (the court's own 'almost none' prior was REFUTED). But a TOTAL WIPEOUT of every AI-compute bond in HYG at a 40c recovery moves HYG to 77.02 - the 77 put still expires WORTHLESS. The trade is 85-90% a bet on SYMPATHETIC broad-HY widening, not on the house mechanism.
why_rejected.horizon_mismatch: Dec-18-2026 covers 0.378y of the 1.416y house window = 27% of the horizon; constant-hazard allocation puts only 14.7% of the 45% inside the option's life. ~30pp of the house's probability mass lands AFTER the option is dead.
why_rejected.horizon_matched_instrument_is_dead: Jan-21-2028 is the ONLY listed HYG expiry covering the house window and carries OI=9 at the 77 strike (DEAD by the house's own OI bands). Its strike ladder is near-linear (77/75/72/70 = 3.50/3.15/2.63/2.30), which reads as stale marks, not a tradeable surface.
why_rejected.live_natural_experiment_refutes_transmis: ORCL has fallen 343.05 -> 131.73 (-62%) and CRWV 153.20 -> 73.66, with CRWV's own bonds at 89-94 / 11.3-12.2% YTW - WHILE broad HY OAS went 292 -> 284bp (TIGHTER) and HYG traded a 12-month raw range of 78.56-81.36, sitting 2.6% off its high. The largest AI-capex repricing of the cycle produced ZERO index transmission.
why_rejected.market_is_segmenting_correctly: HYG's AI sleeve trades at 8.27% YTW vs the fund's 7.15% (+110bp), and CRWV paper at 11-12%. The market is NOT blind - it is pricing the AI credit wide while the other 92% stays tight. Segmentation is precisely what kills a sympathetic-widening bet.
why_rejected.not_a_tail_option: At $0.98 the strike sits only -2.16% from the FORWARD (78.70; the forward is below spot because HYG yields 5.44%). Solved IV 8.97% vs 3.06% realized = ~2.9x rich, and the market charges a 35.6% risk-neutral probability of finishing below 77. The '1.24% of spot / cheap' framing is a dollar-price illusion on a 3%-vol bond fund.
why_rejected.ev_negative_at_the_house_own_central_pri: -27.3% of premium (expiry-basis) at constant hazard; -47% once path-corrected. Positive ONLY under LPPL front-loading, the member the ensemble itself discounts for model-conditionality and pinned-parameter fragility.
why_rejected.upper_bound_makes_the_sleeve_redundant: The 9x steelman requires a general macro risk-off, but the house call is explicitly 'a credit event, NOT an equity drawdown'. In the state where HYG pays 9x, the already-existing deployment-gated XSP program also pays - the AI-specific thesis is not doing the work.

ev.units_discipline: house P=0.45 is TOUCH basis over 1.416y. Dec-18-2026 covers 0.378y = 27% of the horizon. Constant-hazard allocation -> P(event by expiry) = 14.7% [TOUCH]. ~30pp of the 45% lands AFTER expiry. American-style so touch-monetizable, but mark-to-market monetization needs the vol/spread state AT touch, not the terminal distribution.
ev.ev_note: the court's -27.3% is EXPIRY-OPTIMISTIC (scenario table assumes terminal = trough); the independently-derived path-corrected figure is -47% (0.53x premium). BOTH NEGATIVE. Positive only under LPPL front-loading, which the ensemble itself discounts.
ev.decisive_breakeven: at P(event)=14.7%, the put needs E[payoff|event] = $512/lot => HYG must AVERAGE 71.88 conditional on an AI credit event => broad HY OAS must AVERAGE ~589bp across EVERY AI credit event, contained ones included. That is 2.2x today's spread, in Feb-2016/Mar-2020 territory, as an AVERAGE.
ev.roll_cost_note: 1.24% of notional per 4.5mo = ~3.3%/yr; ~3.7 rolls to reach 2027-12-31
ev.tax: HYG options are equity-ETF options and are NOT Section 1256. Gains are short-term ordinary (~50%+); losses are ST capital, absorbable by the harvest engine. Symmetric, so it scales EV rather than flipping its sign - but a winning HYG put is taxed ~23pp worse than the 1256-treated (60/40) XSP program already on the books. Buying options violates NO doctrine (the two-template ruling restricts premium SELLING only).

kg_contributions: INDEX-WEIGHT SCALING LAW for sympathetic credit contagion: transmission tracks the stressed sector's INDEX WEIGHT (telecom ~20%, energy ~11% MV at peak both moved broad HY hundreds of bp; 3.73% cannot). Compute the direct index-weighted effect FIRST, then apply the contagion multiplier (3.6x on direct, verified 2015-16) to THAT - never to the sector's own spread move.

SPREAD TRANSMISSION != CREDIT TRANSMISSION: ex-sector HY spreads widened ~415bp in 2015-16 while ex-energy DEFAULT rates never left 1.5-2.3%. A sector bust re-prices everyone's spread and defaults almost no one else.

SECTOR-STRESS EPISODES ROUND-TRIP FAST: half-retrace ~104d (energy) / ~92d (telecom) / ~3mo (COVID) vs 162d for the GFC. Any option shorter than ~2x the retrace half-life must be underwritten on PATH with a pre-committed touch-monetization rule, never on terminal intrinsic. Path/expiry ratio ~1.78x at 138 days; a 138-day structure captured 1.77% of an 18.93% worst-path payoff in COVID.

BOND-ETF PUTS: convert dollar price to FORWARD-moneyness and IV before calling anything cheap. A high-distribution ETF's forward sits below spot; '1.24% of spot' concealed a strike only -2.16% from forward at ~2.9x realized vol with a 35.6% risk-neutral touch probability.

HY RATE-DURATION IS REGIME-CONDITIONAL: ~1.5 in a crash (fits Mar-2020 exactly), full duration in a rate shock (fits 2022). Model credit-crash payoffs with the CRASH duration and state the Fed-cut offset explicitly. FTQ offset ranged 11-59% in credit-led episodes and -49% in 2022.

AI-CAPEX HY EXPOSURE HIDES IN *COMPUTE LLC / *PROPERTY OWNER 144A PROJECT SPVs, not issuer brand names; three of the largest have no EDGAR presence. An issuer-name keyword sweep understates it ~5x. 144A does not impair index eligibility.

'UNPRICED ONLY WHERE DILUTED' IS A SEGMENTATION TELL, NOT A BLIND SPOT: when a thesis is priced in every specific instrument (ORCL -62%, CRWV bonds 11-12% YTW, the HYG AI sleeve +110bp) and unpriced only in the diluted aggregate, the aggregate is correctly priced.

HORIZON COVERAGE belongs in every option court: state what fraction of the thesis window the expiry covers and what fraction of the probability mass that implies (here 27% of window, ~15% of mass, ~30pp orphaned). Then check whether the horizon-MATCHED instrument actually trades - here Jan-2028 carries OI=9 (DEAD).

WITHIN A SECTOR BUST THE RATING TAIL, NOT THE SECTOR, CARRIES THE IDIOSYNCRATIC MOVE (CCC +1439bp vs BB +350bp in 2015-16) - express sector-credit views down the rating stack, not through the broad index.
